topics.name: Instance and System Config Editor
topics.purpose: Define the Editor surface for instance/system configuration as a schema-driven authorized projection over instance-config and canonical lifecycle operations, including separate IAM parent and AC parent controls.

semantics.schema_rule: Editor fields derive from explicit configuration schema.
semantics.parent_rule: IAM parent and AC parent are separate controls/relations.
semantics.write_rule: Edits write through canonical configuration operations and change-control semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Editor has no privileged configuration bypass.
semantics.preview_rule: Candidate changes may be previewed/validated before apply.
semantics.runtime_rule: Runtime state indicators are shown separately from declared config.
semantics.self_hosting_rule: Editing configuration that affects Expose/Editor still follows normal validation/recovery boundaries.

invariants.rule: Instance identity, configuration parents, activation state and reload behavior remain explicit and do not derive authority from UI or runtime state.
